PROSPECT SUMMARY:
- Company: Verdant Respond AI — ecomm CX platform (merchant-facing support ops).
- Primary need: automatic ticket/email summarization + predictive auto-tagging to drive routing + Zendesk/Freshdesk macro suggestions. Also interested in agent-assist snippets and tool-calling for quick order lookups.
- Scale: ~250 agents currently, expected seasonal spikes up to 900 concurrent tickets (holiday peak).
- Targets: tagging latency ~<200ms for real-time suggestions, summarization complete within 2s for agent view. Throughput target ~50 req/s sustained per region during spikes. Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to pay for reliability during peaks.
POC / TECH DETAILS:
- Current stack: Zendesk (primary), Slack for escalations, internal CRM. PoC to run against Zendesk sandbox + sample historical ticket dump (3M tickets last 2 years).
- Model preference: open-models or Redwood-curated smaller models (quantized) for cost control. Want fallback routing to cheaper LLM when non-critical.
- Requirements: prefix caching for repeated follow-ups, ability to preserve ticket thread context up to 3k tokens, deterministic tag suggestions for A/B testing.
- Security: Must support SSO (SAML), admin audit logs, support for KMS key wrapping, retention controls (90-day short term, 2-year archived), EU data residency for some merchants.

- 2025-10-21: Initial inbound via website form (Maya).
- 2025-10-24: Discovery call — noted heavy spike concerns; asked for Holiday / Black Friday performance examples. (Call notes in ff_2025-10-28).

- POC scope: 2 weeks; run on hosted first (quick start) with option to move to dedicated capacity if performance/cost wins. Data: anonymized ticket dump + live webhook for new tickets.
- Success metrics: tagging precision >=85% on top-5 tags; summary utility score (internal rubric) >=4/5; sub-200ms median tag suggestion latency.
- Quoted concerns: "we can't have noisy tags — manual review overhead kills ROI."
- Integrations checklist: Zendesk triggers for macros, Freshdesk compatibility, Slack alerts on escalations, writeback support for tags & internal notes.
